$comment: AncientVoid hub config — copy to hub.config.json AT THE REPO ROOT (see README Quick Start) and run `node apps/hub/src/main.ts` from there — pwaDir, dataDir and projectRoots below are relative to that CWD, not to this file's own location. hub.config.json is git-ignored; keep secrets out of the repo. projectRoots (T1.5-4): host paths to scan (depth 1) for git repos, offered as session projects in the PWA instead of a free-text path — e.g. ["/home/you/repos"]. Empty means unconfigured: POST /api/sessions accepts any path, same as before this feature existed.

adapters.$comment: Read-only observer for Claude Code sessions started outside AncientVoid. Enable only on a host with the matching ~/.claude/projects transcript store; it never sends prompts to Claude Code.
